app.name: Anakin
app.short_description: Scrape, map, crawl, and search the web, look up Wire site actions, AI-visibility, monitors, and sessions — all from the ticket sidebar.
app.long_description: Anakin adds ten of its web-data lookup tools to the ticket sidebar: scrape a single page, map or crawl a site, run AI-powered or multi-stage agentic search, find and run a read-only Wire catalog action against hundreds of supported sites, ask multiple AI answer engines the same question (AI Visibility), and check existing website monitors and saved browser sessions. Insert any result straight into the ticket as an internal note or public reply — without leaving Zendesk. This app deliberately covers only Anakin's read-oriented/lookup capabilities; state-changing operations (submitting forms, creating monitors, deleting sessions, signing into third-party sites) are out of scope for a support-ticket sidebar — see the project README for the full reasoning.
app.installation_instructions: Create a free API key at anakin.io/dashboard (300 credits, no card required), then paste it into the "Anakin API Key" field below. The key is stored as a secure setting: it never reaches this app's JavaScript in the browser, only Zendesk's own request proxy uses it when calling api.anakin.io on the app's behalf.

apiKey.label: Anakin API Key
apiKey.help: From anakin.io/dashboard. Sent as the X-API-Key header via Zendesk's secure request proxy — never exposed to this app's client-side JavaScript.
